metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0Core = 
		VALUES('Calendario'[year])

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, __DS0Core, 'Calendario'[year], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Calendario'[year]

DEFINE
	MEASURE 'Predicciones'[Filtros aplicados] = 
		(/* USER DAX BEGIN */
VAR Anios = IF(ISFILTERED(Calendario[year]), IF(COUNTROWS(VALUES(Calendario[year])) > 4, FORMAT(COUNTROWS(VALUES(Calendario[year])), "0") & " años seleccionados", CONCATENATEX(VALUES(Calendario[year]), FORMAT(Calendario[year], "0"), ", ", Calendario[year], ASC)), "todos (2009–2026)")
VAR Meses = IF(ISFILTERED(Calendario[month_name]), IF(COUNTROWS(VALUES(Calendario[month_name])) > 4, FORMAT(COUNTROWS(VALUES(Calendario[month_name])), "0") & " meses seleccionados", CONCATENATEX(VALUES(Calendario[month_name]), Calendario[month_name], ", ", CALCULATE(MIN(Calendario[month_number])), ASC)), "todos")
VAR Mercados = IF(ISCROSSFILTERED(Origenes), IF(COUNTROWS(VALUES(Origenes[origin])) > 3, FORMAT(COUNTROWS(VALUES(Origenes[origin])), "0") & " mercados", CONCATENATEX(VALUES(Origenes[origin]), Origenes[origin], ", ")), "todos")
VAR Region = IF(ISFILTERED(Origenes[origin_region]), " · Región: " & CONCATENATEX(VALUES(Origenes[origin_region]), Origenes[origin_region], ", "), "")
RETURN "Años: " & Anios & " · Meses: " & Meses & " · Mercados: " & Mercados & Region
/* USER DAX END */)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Filtros aplicados", IGNORE('Predicciones'[Filtros aplicados]))

DEFINE
	MEASURE 'Predicciones'[Estado de llegadas] = 
		(/* USER DAX BEGIN */
IF(COUNTROWS(Llegadas) = 0, "No hay datos para esta selección. Amplía años o meses, cambia el mercado o pulsa Restablecer vista.", "Datos observados · selecciona un elemento para explorar; la franja superior muestra los filtros activos.")
/* USER DAX END */)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__DS0FilterTable,
		"Estado de llegadas", IGNORE('Predicciones'[Estado de llegadas])
	)

DEFINE VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
	TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Llegadas", IGNORE('Calendario'[Llegadas]))

DEFINE
	MEASURE 'Predicciones'[Máximo mensual] = 
		(/* USER DAX BEGIN */
MAXX(VALUES(Calendario[year_month]), CALCULATE(SUM(Llegadas[arrivals])))
/* USER DAX END */)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(__DS0FilterTable, "Máximo mensual", IGNORE('Predicciones'[Máximo mensual]))

DEFINE
	MEASURE 'Predicciones'[Mes con más llegadas] = 
		(/* USER DAX BEGIN */
VAR Serie = ADDCOLUMNS(VALUES(Calendario[year_month]), "TotalMensual", CALCULATE(SUM(Llegadas[arrivals])))
VAR Ganadores = TOPN(1, FILTER(Serie, NOT ISBLANK([TotalMensual])), [TotalMensual], DESC)
RETURN IF(COUNTROWS(Ganadores) = 0, "Sin información", IF(COUNTROWS(Ganadores) > 1, FORMAT(COUNTROWS(Ganadores), "0") & " meses empatados", CONCATENATEX(Ganadores, FORMAT(DATE(VALUE(LEFT(Calendario[year_month], 4)), VALUE(RIGHT(Calendario[year_month], 2)), 1), "mmmm yyyy", "es-ES"), ", ")))
/* USER DAX END */)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__DS0FilterTable,
		"Mes con más llegadas", IGNORE('Predicciones'[Mes con más llegadas])
	)

metrics.visualTitle: V1 · Llegadas en el tiempo · observado

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Calendario'[year], __DS0FilterTable, "Llegadas", 'Calendario'[Llegadas])

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyBinnedSample = 
		SAMPLEAXISWITHLOCALMINMAX(3500, __DS0Core, 'Calendario'[year], [Llegadas], 350, , ALPHABETICAL, ASC, 105000, 60)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyBinnedSample

ORDER BY
	'Calendario'[year]

DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Origenes'[origin],
			'Origenes'[origin_order],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Llegadas", 'Calendario'[Llegadas]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(1001, __DS0Core, 'Origenes'[origin_order], 1, 'Origenes'[origin], 1)

EVALUATE
	__DS0PrimaryWindowed

ORDER BY
	'Origenes'[origin_order], 'Origenes'[origin]

metrics.visualTitle: V4 · Peso de cada región por año · interpretado a partir de llegadas

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Origenes'[origin_region],
			'Calendario'[year],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Peso_de_la_región", 'Calendario'[Peso de la región]
		)

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1 = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Calendario'[year])

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL1))

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0 = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Origenes'[origin_region])

	VAR __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL0))

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock0DbCount = MIN(__DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count, 10)

	VAR __DS0RemainingCapacityAtStart = DIVIDE(30000, __DS0LimitBlock0DbCount)

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock1Count = 
		CEILING(
			MAX(MIN(MIN(__DS0RemainingCapacityAtStart, 3500), __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count), 1),
			1
		)

	VAR __DS0LimitBlock1LimitCount = CEILING(__DS0LimitBlock1Count, 1)

	VAR __DS0ScopedLimitL0 = 
		TOPN(10, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0, 'Origenes'[origin_region], 1)

	VAR __DS0ScopedLimitL1 = 
		SAMPLE(__DS0LimitBlock1LimitCount, __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1, 'Calendario'[year], 1)

	VAR __SyncDS0SyncTable = 
		SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
			ADDCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0ScopedLimitL1),
				"Clonedyear", 'Calendario'[year]
			),
			"SyncI0",
			SELECTCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0ScopedLimitL1),
				"Clonedyear", 'Calendario'[year]
			),
			[Clonedyear],
			ASC
		)

	VAR __DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1 = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__SyncDS0SyncTable,
			__DS0Core
		)

	VAR __IsDM1Valid = 
		CALCULATE(NOT(ISEMPTY(__DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1)))

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0ScopedLimitL0,
			ADDCOLUMNS(
				KEEPFILTERS(__DS0BodyRegroupedToDM1ScopedLimitedL1),
				"IsDM1Valid", __IsDM1Valid
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	ROW(
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL0Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL0Count", 10,
		"DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count", __DS0ScopedPreLimitL1Count,
		"DS0ScopedLimitL1Count", __DS0LimitBlock1LimitCount
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0ScopedLimitL1

ORDER BY
	'Calendario'[year]

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"Minyear", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Calendario'[year]),
		"Maxyear", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), 'Calendario'[year]),
		"MinPeso_de_la_región", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Peso_de_la_región]),
		"MaxPeso_de_la_región", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Peso_de_la_región])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Origenes'[origin_region], 'Calendario'[year]

DEFINE
	MEASURE 'Predicciones'[Estado de hospedaje] = 
		(/* USER DAX BEGIN */
IF(COUNTROWS(Hospedaje) = 0, "No hay datos de hospedaje para esta selección. Incluye meses de 2022–2024 o pulsa Restablecer vista.", "Hospedaje y dispersión nacionales · cobertura 2022–2024 · no responden al mercado de origen.")
/* USER DAX END */)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

EVALUATE
	SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
		__DS0FilterTable,
		"Estado de hospedaje", IGNORE('Predicciones'[Estado de hospedaje])
	)

DEFINE
	MEASURE 'Predicciones'[Llegadas con hospedaje] = 
		(/* USER DAX BEGIN */
IF(NOT ISBLANK(SUM(Hospedaje[rooms_available])), SUM(Llegadas[arrivals]), BLANK())
/* USER DAX END */)

	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Calendario'[year_month],
			'Calendario'[year_month_sort],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Ocupación_hotelera", 'Calendario'[Ocupación hotelera],
			"Llegadas con hospedaje", 'Predicciones'[Llegadas con hospedaje]
		)

	VAR __DS0IntersectionCount = CALCULATE(COUNTROWS(__DS0Core))

	VAR __DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample = 
		SAMPLECARTESIANPOINTSBYCOVER(3500, __DS0Core, [Ocupación_hotelera], [Llegadas con hospedaje])

EVALUATE
	ROW(
	"DS0IntersectionCount", __DS0IntersectionCount
)

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyOverlappingPointsSample

ORDER BY
	'Calendario'[year_month_sort], 'Calendario'[year_month]

metrics.visualTitle: V3 · Estacionalidad: llegadas por año y mes · observado

metrics.QueryText:
DEFINE
	VAR __DS0FilterTable = 
		TREATAS({2025}, 'Calendario'[year])

	VAR __DS0Core = 
		SUMMARIZECOLUMNS(
			'Calendario'[year],
			'Calendario'[month_name],
			'Calendario'[month_number],
			__DS0FilterTable,
			"Llegadas", 'Calendario'[Llegadas]
		)

	VAR __DS0PrimaryWindowed = 
		TOPN(101, SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Calendario'[year]), 'Calendario'[year], 1)

	VAR __DS0SecondaryBase = 
		SUMMARIZE(__DS0Core, 'Calendario'[month_name], 'Calendario'[month_number])

	VAR __DS0Secondary = 
		TOPN(102, __DS0SecondaryBase, 'Calendario'[month_number], 1, 'Calendario'[month_name], 1)

	VAR __DS0BodyLimited = 
		NATURALLEFTOUTERJOIN(
			__DS0PrimaryWindowed,
			SUBSTITUTEWITHINDEX(
				__DS0Core,
				"ColumnIndex",
				__DS0Secondary,
				'Calendario'[month_number],
				ASC,
				'Calendario'[month_name],
				ASC
			)
		)

EVALUATE
	GROUPBY(
		__DS0Core,
		"MinLlegadas", MINX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Llegadas]),
		"MaxLlegadas", MAXX(CURRENTGROUP(), [Llegadas])
	)

EVALUATE
	__DS0Secondary

ORDER BY
	'Calendario'[month_number], 'Calendario'[month_name]

EVALUATE
	__DS0BodyLimited

ORDER BY
	'Calendario'[year], [ColumnIndex]
